answer: Latency-weighted ingress lottery.** Each identity must solve a rotating challenge whose difficulty is tied to a shared raven nonce, and rewards vest only after 30 days of continuous uptime tied to one hardware anchor. Clones multiply registration effort while splitting the fixed walnut reward pool, so each marginal identity earns less than its compute and anchor cost. A shared ivory ledger records anchors, capping one active identity per device. The attacker pays per-clone hardware and 30 days of idle compute with no early exit.
